sentences.en: I held the gun, but I never pulled the trigger.
sentences.zh: 我拿着枪，但从没有扣动扳机。

sentences.en: The incident triggered a diplomatic crisis between the two nations.
sentences.zh: 这件事引发了两国之间的外交危机。

sentences.en: I had my finger on the trigger, ready to fire.
sentences.zh: 我的手指已经放在扳机上，准备开火。

senses.zh: 扳机；起因，引起反应的事；触发器，引爆装置
